applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Read displaced water as volume and the quotient as mass per volume.

applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Rearrange the ratio for V and check the unit.

applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: A graph crosses at x=−1, touches at x=2, runs down on the left and up on the right and includes (0,8). Give a lowest-degree fitting term and explain the inference limit.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceDe: f(x)=2(x+1)(x−2)² passt: einfaches und doppeltes Nullstellenverhalten, positiver kubischer Leitterm und f(0)=8. Der Graph erzwingt nicht eindeutig, dass kein höhergradiger Term passt.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: f(x)=2(x+1)(x−2)² fits: simple and double zero behavior, positive cubic leading term and f(0)=8. The graph does not uniquely rule out higher-degree fits.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusDe: Graphmerkmale als Bedingungen, nicht als eindeutige Termablesung nutzen.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Use graph features as constraints, not a unique term reading.

applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: g(x)=(x+2)²(x−1)² has double zeros, positive leading coefficient, degree 4 and g(0)=4; higher even degrees may also share the observed properties.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusDe: Berührungen und beidseitiges Endverhalten in Faktoren übersetzen.
